title: Purely Optimized
description: A lightweight, zero-bloat optimization pack for 1.21.11. Specifically tuned for low-end hardware and maximum resource efficiency
body:
Everything you need for a smooth 1.21.11 experience, with zero bloat. This pack is built to make Minecraft run the way it should have from the start.

⭐ Why this?
Maximum FPS: Every setting is pre-tuned for performance.

Low RAM usage: Designed to run smoothly on any setup.

Universal: Works on singleplayer and every multiplayer server.

📥 Environment

Client: Required

Server: Optional
